## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of `fit_soil_water_model()` -- like NO3-N leaching,
this outcome had no formal statistical test before this pipeline, only
descriptive plots. No preliminary figures exist for it, so both figures
here are new (design system).

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(car)
library(emmeans)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_tdr.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_statistics.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Recap -- build the analysis-ready TDR dataset

See `2_preprocessing/04_tdr_import.qmd` for the detailed EDA walkthrough.

```{r recap}
#| message: false
tdr_clean_combined  <- combine_clean_tdr_data(here("1_input_data", "tdr_data"))
tdr_analysis_ready  <- derive_tdr_covariates(tdr_clean_combined)
```

## Step 2: Fit, diagnose, and test

`fit_soil_water_model()`: `SOIL_WATER_CONTENT ~ LOCATION + TREATMENT + CROP`,
no spatial structure (LOCATION is itself a per-nest property here -- see the
function's docstring for why `(1 | SUB_STRIP)` isn't usable), Gamma(link = "log").

```{r fit}
soil_water_fit <- fit_soil_water_model(tdr_analysis_ready)
summary(soil_water_fit)
```

```{r diagnose}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
sw_diag <- diagnose_glmm(soil_water_fit)
plot(sw_diag$sim)
```

```{r anova}
anova_glmm(soil_water_fit)
```

## Step 3: Estimated marginal means (new figure)

```{r emm}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
sw_emm <- emm_soil_water_model(soil_water_fit)
plot_emmeans_effect(
  as.data.frame(sw_emm$emmeans),
  x_var = "LOCATION", colour_var = "TREATMENT",
  colour_values = fertilisation_colors, y_lab = "Soil water content (%)"
)
```
